description: How far a model covers a DMA (wanda_health_v1), from the GIS pipes linked to the model. Not PLDR's dma_state (scored / partial / not_yet_scored), which is about scoring. DMAs only in the clipped GIS (no pipe linked, outside the model extent) get no row, as the PLDR ranking leaves them out.

codes.label: Modelled (more than 50 % of GIS pipes linked)
Partly modelled (50 % or less linked, at least one)
Inside the model extent, no pipe linked
